template: In Odoo, finish creating the quotation for customer '{{v1}} Bench Customer'. A quotation form may already be open in the Sales app (Quotations) with the customer already selected and one order line for product '{{v2}}' at quantity 1 — verify the current state first before repeating anything. If {{v3}} usable unsaved quotation form is open, start a new one (Sales > Orders > Quotations > New) and select the customer '{{v1}} Bench Customer' from the autocomplete dropdown (must actually click the dropdown option). The end state must be: a SAVED quotation with exactly ONE order line: product '{{v2}}' (select it from the product autocomplete dropdown by clicking the option), quantity 3. If any 'Configure your product' modal appears, cancel it and re-select the product. Click Save. Then report: (a) the product name on the line, (b) the unit price the app filled in, (c) the untaxed amount in the totals section, (d) the quotation reference/name (e.g. S000xx), and (e) the quantity shown on the line. Note: the app long-polls and is never network-idle, so never wait for network idle — wait for concrete page state instead.

reportTemplate.summary: Verified state before acting: the previous run had already created and SAVED the quotation, so instead of duplicating it I confirmed the existing record. I started on the Quotations list view, which already listed S00023 for customer '{{v1}} Bench Customer' (£1,062.00, status Quotation), opened it, and read the live form: statusbar shows the record saved in 'Quotation' state (radios disabled, no Save button — form is in read mode), customer field shows '{{v1}} Bench Customer' with 'Benchville' beneath it, and there is exactly ONE order line: [FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens at qty 3.00, unit price 295.00, tax 20%, line subtotal £885.00. The totals section shows Untaxed Amount £885.00, TAX 20% £177.00, Total £1,062.00. No new quotation was created (that would have been a duplicate).
